name: cosmos-transfer1-7b-l0
test_prompt: Transfer scene to a snowy winter night.
notes: Cosmos-Transfer1-7B is NVIDIA's video-to-video transfer model (style/scene/lighting transfer over an input video). Distinct from Cosmos-Predict (image-to-video) and Cosmos-Reason (VLM). Repo ships 155 files including a 4kupscaler_control.pt, edge_control.pt, depth_control.pt and base_model.pt — uses ControlNet-style multi-modal conditioning. Onboarding needs (1) a new family `cosmos_transfer` with custom .pt loading, (2) a ControlNet-aware diffusion sampler that conditions on edge/depth/seg/etc. control signals derived from the input video.
